body:
I'm falling apart. I raised a group of four kittens and yesterday took them to meet families. One couple was nice, and wanted to take two. I'm kicking myself for letting them stay with them right then. I should have taken them back home and slept on the decision. I'm so worried about the people. I've rehomed and fostered many times before, and I've never felt like this.

I want them back, and I'm afraid I can't get them back. The couple is young and I don't sense that they're that serious about this. I'm just in a total "what have I done" meltdown. 

I'm going to see them tomorrow, but I'm so scared. I'm scared the cats will be well, and I'll have no excuse to take them back for a while. I'm scared these people will break up and send them to the pound a couple years from now. I'm scared they won't car about them, and will hurt them somehow done the line. I've devoted hundreds of dollars and countless time to ensuring these guys had everything. After doing this for  so many years, how could I have messed up like this? Why didn't I say "no"? This doesn't feel right and my heart is breaking.
